correctness.rationale: Two-position read differences force exactly one first-to-last interval of opposite alternating phases, including adjacent single-letter substitutions. Read-coordinate difference supports of a clique relative to a base are pairwise intersecting 2-sets. Three distinct supports forming a triangle violate the signed incidence-sum conservation law over the torsion-free free abelian group; therefore distinct supports share a center. Repeated supports force a single-coordinate q-star. Otherwise at most n supports exist, with equality forcing a globally alternating precursor by local multiset agreement. Both constructions attain bounds and are disjoint for n>=2; n=1 complete graph is treated separately. Independently enumerated maximal cliques in ten small q,n instances and matched size/count.
